spans.s: ञ्य taddhita affix य signifying the substitution of vrddhi as also the acute accent for the first vowel of the word to which it is added. It is added (1) to words headed by प्रगदिन् in the four senses termed वंतुरर्थ e.g.प्रागृद्यम्, शारद्यम् etc.;cf.
; (2).to 20 the word गम्भीर and अव्ययीभाव com- pounds in the sense of present there', e.g. गाम्भीर्यम् , पारिमुख्यम् etc. cf.

ञ्यङ् tad. affix in the sense of 'a des- cendant' added to words beginn- ing with अा, ऐ, ओ or ending with इ, as also to the words कौसल and अजाद् provided they mean a coun- try and a Ksatriya too; e.g. सौवीर्यः, आवन्त्यः, कौन्त्यः कौसल्यः, अाजाद्यः; cf.

ञ्यट् tad. affix य .causing वृद्धि to the first vowel of the word to which it is added and the addition of ई ( ङीप् ) in the sense of feminine gender, added to words meaning warrior tribes of the Vahika coun- try but not Brahmanas or Ksatri- yas. e.g. क्षौद्रक्यः, क्षौद्रक्री etc.; cf
